description: This file defines the {@code Attributes} interface, which models entity attributes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for creating, modifying, and converting attribute data, and extends multiple base interfaces related to JSON serialization and field selection. The interface includes methods for setting values of various data types and generating builders for attribute objects.

classes.name: Attributes
classes.description: An interface representing static and dynamic attributes of an entity, allowing creation and modification of key-value pairs with support for JSON serialization and field selection.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing Attributes instances.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current Attributes, allowing for fluent modifications.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key with various data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue).

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField into the Attributes.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JsonFields to the Attributes.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair identified by the key.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Attributes to a JsonObject, given a schema version and a field selector.
